bio.text: The Arizona Capitol Times reported in December 2024 that Democrat Brian Garcia was making his House debut representing Legislative District 8.
He served as president of the Tempe Union High School District governing board during the height of the Covid pandemic.

Garcia began working in public policy in the U.S. House of Representatives for then-Congresswoman Kyrsten Sinema, later pursued a law degree, and worked as a law clerk for the Pascua Yaqui Tribe, of which he is a member.

sources.title: New Faces: Brian Garcia | Arizona Capitol Times
